ko.name: Agent Wiki Studio
ko.body_markdown_inline:
Ops surface. In-process KnowledgeBaseWikiUI Ledger (fixedSurface=studio). full CLI product agent-wiki in Helpers+PATH via ADM extra_clis/full_cli_product.

**구성**
Ops surface. In-process KnowledgeBaseWikiUI Ledger (fixedSurface=studio). full CLI product agent-wiki in Helpers+PATH via ADM extra_clis/ful

**CLI**
PATH CLI `agent-wiki-studio` 로 조회·조작한다.

**Dual-entry**
GUI는 앱, CLI는 Helpers 바이너리. GUI를 PATH에 심링크하지 않는다.
